title: Will this stage use the cluster evenly?
description: Change the workload, exchange strategy, partition count, available task slots, and hot-key pressure. The model separates average parallelism from the task that controls stage completion.

scenarios.label: Balanced aggregation
scenarios.detail: Group 600 GiB of projected events by a high-cardinality key with broadly distributed traffic.

scenarios.label: Skewed aggregation
scenarios.detail: Group the same events when one customer or empty-key bucket owns a large share of rows.

scenarios.label: Fact-to-dimension join
scenarios.detail: Join an 800 GiB fact table with a measured 12 GiB dimension after projection and filtering.

strategies.label: Plain hash exchange
strategies.detail: Redistribute rows by key. It is general, but one hot key still lands in one reducer partition.

strategies.label: Salt the hot key
strategies.detail: Split dominant keys across eight buckets, then merge partial results. This adds work but reduces the largest reducer.

strategies.label: Broadcast the bounded side
strategies.detail: Send the projected dimension to every executor and keep the large fact partitions in place.

notice: This is an explanatory planning model, not a Spark benchmark. Real shuffle size, broadcast safety, task memory, adaptive execution, serialization, compression, storage, and network behavior must be measured from representative runs.
